This is the Daily chart where I identified 5 daily highs, and the FLs I believe were formed as each high was broken. I drilled down on H4 to find the high and low of the FL where it wasn't clear on the D1 chart. I then noted what happened on the FTB and subsequent visits to each FL.

The above shows the levels I looked into. Blue dotted lines for the highs that were broken. Red rectangles for the FLs, numbered 1 to 5.

This is the first FL, showing 2 bounces on reaction to it.

2nd one had two good reactions and one 'almost touched':)

Two good reactions to this one.

This one, I'm guessing was of lesser importance. Sadly I don't have history to the left in this case as I started at the beginning of this chart. There was no reaction on return to it, and another, larger FL was created immediately above it, which generated lots of fun reactions!

This 5th one was the money maker, with 4 or 5 good chances to trade bounces from the top of it. When it finally broke, it also went straight through the level below.

I thought it was worth drilling into the LTFs to see if there was any reaction at all the the 4th level, but could not see anything.

So, in conclusion, level 4 sucks, and I need to base my next homework on levels with more history:)
